text: Badge #0001 — Hakaka is Born. Wind says hak-ak; fingers twist grass; name binds: Hakaka. Law 1: Ohne Griff kein Beginn. Greif, dann benenn.
Badge #0002 — The First Knot. La-la pulls hard; knot laughs, holds. Law 2: Test vor Vertrauen. Lachen nach der Kontrolle.
Badge #0003 — Whisper Net. Ya-la sinks a stone; three pulls answered. Law 3: Leise macht lang. Schwere macht Worte ehrlich.
Badge #0004 — Fire Obsession. Sa-la sparks; clay makes heat friendly. Law 4: Feuer dient, wenn es gebunden ist.
Badge #0005 — The Robe Remembers. Fabric warms on truth, grows heavy on lies. Law 5: Was gestern brannte, wärmt heute, wenn du es gut bindest.
